# DisorderInducedTopology

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The phenomenon where disorder in a material can stabilize or destroy topological phases, affecting the system's computational or signal-processing capabilities. Informs how neuromorphic hardware can leverage or mitigate disorder to maintain reliable in-network processing under real-world noise conditions.
